facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance's PFM Reform Strategy 2026-2030 lists developing a central data exchange platform as a priority measure, with piloting and rollout phased after working-group and data-standards stages, and says lack of interoperability between PFM IT systems limits consolidation of financial information.

note: as_of is the strategy's published date, as the document gives no other date for the state of systems.
Companion page holds citation and structure only; it states nothing about a data exchange platform.

The Auditor-General found seven revenue systems not connected to SFMIS (2025 audit, reported 2026-08-10); this is the financial management system and system-to-system links, not a data exchange platform or its absence, so no fact.
The document states nothing this study asks.
